scope: 19 owner-supplied Further Mathematics June 2025 questions and their complete question-specific official mark schemes.
sourcePolicy: Only owner-supplied PDF bytes; source documents remain unchanged. Native question HTML and mathematics; two exact source diagram crops. Applicable original working and precision instructions preserved separately as contextHtml. Complete question-specific solutions, alternatives, marking notes and examiner diagrams preserved as lossless source crops. Administrative cover matter and general examiner boilerplate are not repeated per question.
coordinateSystem: PDF MediaBox points, top-left origin; one-based source pages; crop rectangles [left,top,right,bottom]. CropBox offsets applied before rendering source crops.
